benchmark_flash_attention_fp8: benchmark flash attention fp8 forward pass across Pytorch, Flash3, cuDNN and Triton implementations
run_cudnn_spda_setup: run cudnn_spda_setup to build and execute a cuDNN FP8 scaled dot-product attention graph
